name: Environment Variable Check
description: Verifies required environment variables are set at session start by checking .env.example or a custom required-vars list
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Verify required environment variables at session start
ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ".")
MISSING=0
# Check from .env.example if it exists
if [[ -f "$ROOT/.env.example" ]]; then
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    # Skip comments and empty lines
    [[ "$line" =~ ^#.*$ || -z "$line" ]] && continue
    VAR_NAME=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f1 | tr -d ' ')
    if [[ -z "${!VAR_NAME}" ]] && ! grep -q "^${VAR_NAME}=" "$ROOT/.env.local" 2>/dev/null && ! grep -q "^${VAR_NAME}=" "$ROOT/.env" 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "WARNING: Required env var $VAR_NAME is not set"
      MISSING=$((MISSING + 1))
    fi
  done < "$ROOT/.env.example"
  if [[ $MISSING -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "$MISSING required environment variable(s) missing. Check .env.local"
  fi
fi
exit 0
